tbesh_html:
1) fingernail, stylus point
1a) finger-nail
1b) point (of a diamond)
Aramaic equivalent: te.phar (טְפַר "nail/claw" H2953)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, a claw, i.e. (human) nail; also the point of astyle (or pen, tipped with adamant)
strongs_1890.derivation: from H6852 (צָפַר) (in the denominative sense (from H6833 (צִפּוֹר)) of scratching);

occurrences.bsb: then you shall bring her into your house. She must shave her head, trim her nails,
occurrences.kjv: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;

occurrences.bsb: “The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
occurrences.kjv: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
